title: Sfumato Supervision: Learning Instance Segmentation with Noisy Labels
abstract: arXiv:2406.10891v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Instance segmentation requires precise object masks, yet both human annotators and promptable models can produce unreliable contours. A high prediction loss near a contour does not necessarily indicate an annotation error: valid edges can also be uncertain. Inspired by Leonardo da Vinci's \emph{sfumato}, which softens transitions between a subject and its surroundings, we introduce \textbf{\texttt{CB-LNL} (Copula-Boundary Learning with Noisy Labels)}. Rather than judging each contour pixel alone, CB-LNL combines foreground evidence inside the mask with background evidence outside it to guide local supervision and annotation repair. We ground this approach in an audit of paired COCO and LVIS annotations, and introduce benchmarks covering human annotations, weak-prompt SAM2 masks, and controlled corruptions in natural and driving scenes. translated_title: 晕涂法监督：带噪声标签的实例分割学习
translated_abstract: 实例分割需要精确的目标掩膜，然而无论是人工标注者还是可提示模型都可能产生不可靠的轮廓。轮廓附近的高预测损失并不一定意味着标注错误：有效的边缘同样可能是不确定的。受列奥纳多·达·芬奇“晕涂法”的启发——该技法柔化主体与其周围环境之间的过渡——我们提出了 CB-LNL（基于Copula的带噪声标签边界学习）。CB-LNL 不再单独评判每个轮廓像素，而是结合掩膜内部的前景证据与掩膜外部的背景证据，以引导局部监督和标注修复。我们通过对 COCO 和 LVIS 配对标注的审计为该方法奠定基础，并引入了涵盖人工标注、弱提示 SAM2 掩膜以及自然场景与驾驶场景中受控污染的基准测试。受控比较表明，该方法在程序化轮廓噪声下改善了训练效果，并减少了有害的……
tldr: 该论文受达芬奇“晕涂法”启发提出 CB-LNL 方法，通过联合利用掩膜内前景证据与掩膜外背景证据来区分真实的不确定边缘与标注噪声，从而引导局部监督并自动修复实例分割中的噪声标签。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CB-LNL, a sfumato-inspired approach that combines foreground evidence inside the mask with background evidence outside it to distinguish genuinely uncertain edges from annotation noise, enabling guided local supervision and automatic repair of noisy labels in instance segmentation.
